items.name: Blood Caimon Tacos
items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, these spicy and flavorful tacos will surprise & delight any diners!
Enjoyer of these tacos is granted the Caimon Taco Buff, which grants +20 movement on a charge attack, a 20 swim speed and the ability to charge through water, and the ability to hold one's breath for 30 minutes.

items.name: Desert Coffee
items.description:

items.name: Bone Dice
items.description: Made from most creatures, mainly ankle bones from animals or otherwise, however, hooves, horns, and even antlers were also used. In the past the dice were not used for games, were used by religious figures with rocks, sticks, or even animal entrails, for fortune-telling. In some of the more remote regions playing dice might be an insult and is advisable against it.

items.name: Bullseye Rum
items.description:
“It hits you right in the center, just not in a good way.”
Bullseye Rum is the drink of choice for the truly desperate, the miserly, or those who simply value quantity over quality. Its dark amber hue suggests a richness it absolutely does not deliver. The label, featuring a dartboard and the motto "Bullseye," is both an ironic jab at the drink's questionable aftereffects and a promise of its unerring ability to ruin your stomach. items.description:
Price 500 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionA sextant is used to determine your latitude. Using a sextant with an astrolabe gives you a +4 circumstance bonus on Survival checks made to prevent getting lost.

items.name: Blood Caimon Hide
items.description:
Caimon Hide Armor is Buoyant and it bestows no armor check penalty on Swim checks attempted by the wearer. 
It's smooth texture allows for smooth movement through water, granting a small swim-skill bonus.  
It is slightly lighter than conventional hide armor, and allows for greater dexterity. 
All other armor check penalties apply as normal.

items.name: Spellbook
items.description: A spellbook has 100 pages of parchment, and each spell takes up one page per spell level (one page each for 0-level spells). A newly purchased spellbook contains no spells. A wizard character begins play with a spellbook containing the spells he knows.

items.description:

items.name: Amulet of Natural Armor +1
items.description:
This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales—toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.
